name: Palm wine, alcohol and tea to bring in milk
what_people_do: Mothers drink tea, hot water, palm wine or other alcoholic drinks to "improve the flow" of breast milk.
why_they_say_it_works: Warm or fermented drinks are believed to open the milk.

documented_by.source: Udigwe GO, Emelumadu OF, Udigwe IB 2013, West Afr J Med, PMID 24488282
documented_by.quote_or_summary: Nnewi: 53.3% took tea, 30.3% palm wine and 19.4% hot water to improve milk flow.

documented_by.source: Okeke T et al 2013, Ann Med Health Sci Res, PMID 23634329
documented_by.quote_or_summary: Enugu: 25.2% drank various alcoholic beverages to induce lactation.

evidence.population: Cochrane: 41 RCTs, 3,005 mothers of term infants
evidence.finding: Overall certainty low to very low; evidence for natural galactagogues is weak (alcohol and palm wine are not among the interventions I read).

source.name: Oral galactagogues for increasing breast milk, Cochrane 2020, PMID 32421208

evidence.tested: Palm wine or alcohol for lactation

source.name: agent4-traditional-practices.md, 12 Nov 2026 (research file in this project)

harm_note: Alcohol passes into breast milk (general pharmacology, not from these sources). The Nnewi authors flagged dangerous practices without detail in the abstract.
gaps: Moringa as a galactagogue has systematic-review evidence (PMID 40724308) I did not read.
